generation.call_history: One initial generation and one explicitly authorized targeted edge edit per asset; no further regeneration or mechanical pixel editing.

assets.label: Genetics Army — standard guard
assets.prompt:
Create exactly ONE full-body 2D fighting-game character asset: the standard Genetics Army guard from Metal Gear Ac!d (PSP), using the supplied official-design model sheet as the visual authority. The intended guard is the LEFT TWO drawings on the reference sheet (front and back views of the same grey-camouflage helmeted soldier). Do not use or blend the two tan-uniform soldiers on the right.

Preserve the reference uniform and its ordinary human proportions closely: charcoal and medium-grey irregular urban camouflage fatigues; scuffed light beige/tan combat helmet, small black helmet mount, small red circular detail at the temple and restrained red/black attachment at rear; black balaclava with exposed eyes; ochre/tan ammunition chest webbing with paired large rectangular pouches and dark harness straps; beige protective sections at the elbows/forearms and knees/shins arranged as shown; black gloves; dark thigh straps and holster; pale gaiter sections and dark-soled combat boots. Keep the characteristic division between cloth, webbing and protective sections. This is a normal standard soldier, NOT the massive unused Genetics soldier boss and not a science-fiction cyborg.

Adapt the neutral model-sheet pose into a readable CQC fighting stance: three-quarter side view facing RIGHT, head looking right, knees slightly flexed, feet clearly separated, one gloved fist forward and the other guarding the chest, balanced human anatomy. Unarmed hand-to-hand stance; do not introduce a gun or new weapon. Preserve complete body, both boots, helmet and hands with generous transparent padding. The soldier occupies about 85 percent of the image height.

Render as a polished high-resolution 2D game illustration with precise ink contours, hand-painted tonal shading, muted reference colors, clear silhouette and crisp individual equipment forms. Native high-detail portrait output suitable for a fighting-game sprite. Single character, single pose only. TRUE transparent RGBA background with clean alpha edges. No background scene, no ground plane, no drop shadow, no checkerboard, no labels, no text, no logo, no watermark, no second view, no montage, no decorative effects. Uniform design fidelity takes priority over adding detail.

visual_review.background: Transparent RGBA; no scene, text or checkerboard.
known_limitations: Some fine red/yellow fringe remains after the edit; these files are integration candidates, not edge-perfect final art.
Native dimensions below UHD; no upscaling.
Minor interior painted texture differences from v1 despite targeted edit.
visual_review.improvement: White protrusion above helmet removed; prominent fringe specks reduced. Main costume, pose and proportions retained.

versions.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit the attached single transparent Genetics Army soldier sprite with a narrowly targeted alpha-edge cleanup. Preserve the exact character design, grey camouflage, tan helmet and chest pouches, gloves, equipment, anatomy, proportions, face, right-facing CQC pose, framing, line art and interior shading. Remove ONLY stray saturated red/yellow outline pixels, colored specks, ghost pixels and edge halos outside the true character silhouette. Remove the small unnatural white triangular protrusion above the top of the helmet, restoring the smoothly rounded tan helmet contour visible below it. The intentional small RED helmet indicator at the temple is part of the costume and MUST remain red; do not erase the red equipment detail on the helmet itself. Clean neutral anti-aliased edges should blend directly to alpha, with no red/yellow matte. Keep the outside area genuinely fully transparent RGBA and the soldier visually opaque. Keep both complete boots and both fists. Do not redesign or move anything, do not add any object, no background, no floor or shadow, no texture behind the figure, no text, no extra character. This is the same image with corrected edge artifacts, not a new illustration.
versions.verdict: Visible improvement: white triangular protrusion above helmet removed, several prominent red/yellow specks reduced. Fine red/yellow fringe remains at some edges. Costume, general pose and proportions retained, minor painted texture differences.
